answer: Each agent identity must post a 1000-token bond denominated in the network's umber credit unit, escrowed for 30 epochs; the k-th additional identity requires a quadratic bond of 1000·k² tokens, so minting 100 Sybils costs over 10 million. Bonds are slashed if a gale of disputed attestations—5 or more nectar-weighted peer rejections—lands within 3 epochs, making bulk forgery economically ruinous.
